Akane Torikai’s Dystopian Shojo Manga 'Wandering Cat's Cage' Released via Takumigraphics

New Dystopian Release

Takumigraphics, the East Asian-focused imprint of Fantagraphics, has released Wandering Cat's Cage, a new dystopian shojo manga by author Akane Torikai. Known for her work on Sensei’s Pious Lie, Torikai’s latest project was developed in collaboration with Mangasplaining Extra (MSX).

Stylistic Significance

According to Fantagraphics Vice President Eric Reynolds, the title draws inspiration from established dystopian traditions set by creators like Moto Hagio and Katsuhiro Otomo. The work is characterized as a reflection of contemporary social themes through a shojo lens.

Availability

Wandering Cat's Cage is currently available in bookstores. Readers can verify the release and view preview imagery through the publisher's official documentation and distribution channels. For additional details regarding this release, visit: https://www.ign.com/articles/wandering-cats-cage-is-a-dystopian-manga-worth-reading.
